cause_quote: The new full-output inspector set the state to unavailable under `if (!output || output.outputText === undefined)` and rendered copy and download controls whenever `this.loadState === "loading"` was false.
user_saw: Opening a successful image-only tool result showed “Full output unavailable” and offered copy and download controls that exported empty text.
summary: The Control UI now accepts a uniquely matched completed result without text and shows copy and download controls only when there is text to export.
reasoning: The introducing diff replaced the Markdown details view with a full-output inspector that treated missing text as a failed lookup, even though the tool-card extractor returns undefined text for image-only content. Both Solid refactors carried forward that availability check and the export controls, so the defect shipped with the original inspector.
